composite_formula: ETM_v2 = mean(TRD, HS, DAM, SFD, LBS, AKM, MCC, RRF, VPS)  with each feature in [0,1]

TRD.name: Tension-Resolution Depth
TRD.extraction: Sethares roughness dissonance curve over time; integrate (peak - resolution) * delay; normalize by max-window-roughness.
TRD.fallback_status_without_librosa: PARTIAL — scipy spectrogram + custom roughness implementation possible but less accurate

HS.name: Harmonic Surprise
HS.extraction: Estimate chord sequence via chromagram + Krumhansl-Schmuckler template matching; compute Bayesian surprise of each transition under Western-tonal n-gram prior.

DAM.name: Dynamic Arc Magnitude
DAM.extraction: RMS energy envelope; compute (max_rms - min_rms) in dB; normalize by /60dB clipped to [0,1].

SFD.name: Spectral Fusion Density
SFD.extraction: 1 - spectral_flatness averaged across the piece; bonus for high harmonic/percussive ratio (HPSS).

LBS.name: Lament-Bass Descent
LBS.extraction: Bass-pitch tracker (lowest-formant or pYIN low band); detect stepwise-descending sequences of >= 4 notes within a tetrachord; score by total descent count weighted by length.

AKM.name: Ascending Key Modulation
AKM.extraction: Segment-wise key detection (Krumhansl-Schmuckler, 8-second windows); count ascending-key-change events; normalize by piece length minutes.

MCC.name: Motif Circularity Closure
MCC.extraction: DTW similarity between first-N seconds and last-N seconds of piece (N = 15s default); higher similarity = higher MCC.
MCC.audio_dependency: scipy + custom DTW; librosa.feature.mfcc preferred for features

RRF.name: Tempo Rubato Flexibility
RRF.extraction: Beat-tracker tempo curve over time; compute std(tempo) / mean(tempo); normalize to [0,1] via tanh scaling.

VPS.name: Vocal Performance Signature (composite, 6 sub-features)
VPS.composite_formula: mean(VSF, LTS, VCM, GMP, TEI, CRA)

VSF.name: Vocal-stack Spectral Fusion
VSF.extraction: LPC formant estimation per voice; cross-channel formant-coherence + spectral-flatness inversion within 200-3500 Hz vocal band.

LTS.name: Lead-voice Tessitura + Strain
LTS.extraction: Pitch tracker (pYIN); upper-quartile pitch relative to typical-male-tenor-range (130-525 Hz) for vocal music; vibrato-rate via autocorrelation on pitch trace.

VCM.name: Vocal-Color Modulation across arc
VCM.extraction: Spectral-centroid trajectory; segment-wise mean-shift detection; per-segment vowel/timbre classification via formant pattern.

GMP.name: Grit/Melisma at Peaks
GMP.extraction: Spectral-kurtosis at energy-peak windows (top 10% RMS); melisma-density via pitch-trajectory note-density at peaks.
GMP.audio_dependency: librosa.pyin preferred for melisma; scipy.stats.kurtosis for grit

TEI.name: Tag-Ending Intensification
TEI.extraction: Compare final-third RMS-mean + pitch-mean to middle-third; detect repeated final-phrase via self-similarity matrix in last 30 seconds.

CRA.name: Call-and-Response Architecture
CRA.extraction: Voice-activity-detection alternation pattern; count antiphonal entries; speaker-diarization-light via spectral-clustering of frames.
